purpose: Execute the atomic loft-between-sections operation within the MA-10 boundary: Current native solid variant: Loft.Create consumes exactly two supplied planar sheet sections. Section creation is caller-owned; periodic lofts, cap construction, profile-loop creation, and persistence are outside this atom.
trigger: Use when the build plan requires loft-between-sections and all declared inputs have been resolved for the current SpaceClaim V21 action boundary.

inputs.name: section_faces
inputs.description: Exactly two distinct current faces, each the only face of one planar sheet body.

inputs.name: ruled
inputs.description: Selects ruled versus smooth native Loft behavior.

inputs.name: section_policy
inputs.description: The current atom requires native loft consumption of both supplied sheet sections.

preconditions: section_faces contains exactly two distinct current planar faces.
Each section face is the only face of a distinct current open sheet body.
ruled is boolean and section_policy is exactly consume.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: A newly detected closed, manifold, positive-volume current root DesignBody; the two sheet sections are consumed.

postconditions: Loft.Create is called with the two face selections, ForceIndependent, the supplied ruled value, and PeriodicBlend=false.
Exactly one new current root DesignBody is detected with closed positive volume, and both source sheet bodies are consumed.
The loft result is manifold and passes the closed-solid assertion.

Stop and record the observed kernel lifecycle; rerun only after the declared consume policy is confirmed for the exact action version.
